slots_and_copies.name: slot_0
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Single SRAM image at 0x0E000000. FUN_08000e90 loads and validates (sum8 + dword check, 2 attempts, returns 0/-1/-2); FUN_0801da54 uses defaults via FUN_08000fb0 on failure. No slot offset, bank switch, mirror, or generation counter proven; an in-RAM restore copy inside FUN_08000e90 (unresolved offset/count) is not mapped to a SRAM slot.

checksums.name: sum8_candidate_at_0x7d58
checksums.formula_detail: FUN_08000c4c: c=0; for p in [base,base+len): c=(c+*p)&0xFF. FUN_08000c64 stores it at base+store_off in RAM; FUN_08000c38 reads stored byte; FUN_08000e90 validates (computed-stored)&0xFF==0 in up to 2 attempts. Code-proven algorithm; base/len/store_off are unresolved literal-pool values. Byte-side candidate: covered [0,0x3DA4) stored at 0x7D58; any covered end in [0x3DA4,0x7D50) gives identical sum on cap-01 due to zero gap, so exact covered_end is undistinguished. Full-image sum8[0,0x8000)=0xFD vs last byte 0x00 does not match a stored-at-end reading.

io_driver_functions.notes: Byte-copy src->dst after WAITCNT-style register OR 3. Called as (RAM,0x0E000000,0x8000). SRAM write primitive; not Flash/EEPROM/DMA3.

Unrecovered jumptable body. Reader call (0x0E000000,RAM,len,*lit) copies SRAM->RAM; writer call (RAM,0x0E000000,0x8000,*lit) returns 0 on success after write, verify/compare-like. Exact implementation unknown.
Returns *(u8*)(lit_base+lit_off): stored checksum byte; operands unresolved.
Recomputes sum8 and stores at base+store_off in RAM only.
Load+validate: SRAM->RAM copy, sum8 check (2 attempts, 0/-1), dword check (-2), optional param==1 in-RAM restore copy + FUN_08000c64.
Only traced SRAM flush: FUN_08000c64 then up to 2x FUN_080e30f8(RAM,0x0E000000,0x8000) + FUN_080e3268 verify, break on 0.
Defaults/new-save RAM initializer; no SRAM access. See caller_chains.
Boot-time RAM mirror clear + tail-call FUN_08000fb0; textual caller FUN_08000628 only, graph edge absent (jumptable). No SRAM erase.

Candidate checksum sum8[0:0x3DA4]=0x69 at 0x7D58 matches on the sole populated sample; any covered end in [0x3DA4,0x7D50) matches identically. Needs a second valid .sav to confirm/refute.
